name: Universal Transformer · ACT
tagline: Let each token accumulate enough computation to halt.
description: A causal nanochat adaptation of Universal Transformer with Adaptive Computation Time. Halting mass accumulates across recursions, intermediate states are combined, and a ponder cost regularizes computation depth.
mechanism: 3 prelude + 6 core blocks × up to 3 recursions + 3 coda
Coordinate signals, accumulated halting mass and a final remainder
Language-model loss plus ACT ponder cost
limitations: The reference path computes every candidate recursion. Average exit depth does not imply lower training compute.
